subject: Electronics & Hardware
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Information and Communication Technology Skills-III in CBSE Class 11 Electronics & Hardware.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Electronics & Hardware (847), Unit-3: Information and Communication Technology Skills-III covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
